info.title: AOS-S Switches
info.description: API service to run troubleshooting tests on devices - Access Points (APs), CX Switches, AOS-S Switches, and Gateways (GWs).

tags.name: AOS-S Switches
tags.description: Troubleshooting operations on AOS-S Switches (The stackId should be used in place of the serial for stack switches)

post.summary: Initiate a Cable Test on a AOS-S Switch
post.description: Starts an asynchronous Cable Test on the specified AOS-S Switch.

202.description: Accepted. The operation has been successfully initiated. The response includes the location to track the operation's status.

requestBody.description: AOS-S Switch Cable Test command parameters

get.summary: Get AOS-S Switch Cable Test status and results
get.description: Retrieves the status and results of a previously initiated asynchronous AOS-S Switch Cable Test.

200.description: OK. Returns the status and results of the AOS-S Switch Cable Test.

completed.summary: AOS-S Switch Cable Test completed successfully

get.summary: List active async tasks for an AOS-S Switch
get.description: Retrieves a list of all active or recently completed asynchronous operations for the specified AOS-S Switch, grouped by test name. Results are sorted by startTime in descending order (most recently started first).

200.description: OK. Returns the list of active/recent tasks.

post.description: Initiates a locate (e.g., blinking LED) operation on the specified AOS-S Switch.

202.description: Accepted. The locate action has been successfully initiated.

get.description: Returns most used/top 'show' commands supported on given AOS-S switch.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous execution of one or more 'show' commands on an AOS-S switch. Rejected with 400 if any command does not start with 'show ', or if more than 20 commands are provided.

requestBody.description: The list of 'show' commands to run.

get.description: Polls the async task for the 'show' commands and returns status and raw text output.
